image_description: Two common iguanas resting on a paved surface with some grass. The iguana in the foreground is larger, displaying a prominent dorsal crest and long tail extending towards the bottom left. The second iguana is in the background to the right, facing left. Both exhibit greenish-grey coloration typical of adult iguanas.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is large and triangular with a prominent dewlap (loose skin fold) hanging from the throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both iguanas clearly display the characteristic triangular head shape and visible dewlaps under the chin.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large with round pupils and golden irises.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye of the foreground iguana is visible and consistent with the description; the background iguana's eye is also visible though less detailed due to distance/resolution.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: A large circular subtympanic shield (scale) is present below the tympanum.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The large circular scale behind the jawline is visible on the foreground iguana.
Both subjects have the thick, cylindrical body shape characteristic of iguanas.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coloration is bright green in juveniles, becoming darker green to greyish-green in adults with broad black bands on the body and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is greyish-green with darker banding, consistent with adult common iguanas.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Row of enlarged, spine-like scales running from the nape along the midline of the back to the tail base, forming a serrated crest.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal crest is highly prominent and structurally correct on both iguanas, especially the foreground one.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is covered in small, granular scales with larger, plate-like scales on the head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Texture analysis shows distinct granular scaling on the body and larger plates on the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are long and muscular with five clawed digits on each foot.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front limbs of the foreground iguana are clearly visible, showing muscular structure and distinct digits/claws.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and longer than body, used for balance and defense.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail of the foreground iguana is very long, extending out of frame, and appears laterally compressed with banding.

selected_experts.reason: Verify species classification as Iguana iguana against similar lizard species.
Verify species classification for the second subject.
Audit limb connectivity and structural integrity of the complex pose.
Check for edge bleeding between the dorsal crest/spines and the background pavement.
Assess overall texture consistency and noise levels.

focus_areas: Dorsal crest continuity and connection to the spine
Digit count and claw definition on forelimbs
Boundary sharpness between iguana skin and pavement
Consistency of scale texture across body regions
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the dorsal spines and the background. AI models often struggle with the fine, thin geometry of the crest, causing it to melt into the background or appear disconnected. Also verify that the shadow cast by the foreground iguana aligns correctly with the light source implied by the background iguana's shadow.
